sprint.name: Forge Expansion Sprint
sprint.note: A scheduled review is not a guaranteed release. The forge publishes at most one coherent change when it clears the quality and safety gates; otherwise it skips the window.
sprint.secondaryAutomation: A separate GitHub Actions workflow runs Tuesday and Friday at 15:17 UTC. It can only create or improve approved declarative-engine apps and records accepted publishes in this ledger.

method.label: Inspect
method.description: Review the live site, repository, current apps, open feedback, bugs, depth, accessibility, and portfolio gaps.

method.label: Compare
method.description: Consider at least three candidate changes and choose the one that creates the strongest useful depth or breadth.

method.label: Build one
method.description: Create or improve one coherent feature or app, including mobile, keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, teardown, and edge cases.

method.label: Validate
method.description: Run JavaScript syntax checks, feedback-routing tests, registry rules, required-file checks, and safety-boundary validation.

method.label: Publish or skip
method.description: Merge and deploy only after every required check passes. Skip when the candidate is weak, unsafe, duplicative, or incomplete.

qualityGates: One coherent change maximum per review window
No secrets, trackers, accounts, hidden storage, or unreviewed network behavior
No direct execution of user feedback
Mobile, keyboard, touch, focus, and reduced-motion behavior considered
Repository validation must pass before main is published

queue.title: Folding Frontier 1.1.1 keyboard regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify Enter on Submit fold, Preview best bond, Undo move, Call folding mentor, New session, and numbered bond buttons performs only the focused action; verify arrow keys on focused buttons do not rotate or change selection; confirm global arrow, H, U, and Enter shortcuts still work from the canvas and non-interactive regions; confirm repeated close and reopen cycles remove old listeners.

queue.title: Collection Navigator stability regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify late-loading cards trigger one bounded refresh, sorting no longer self-schedules renders, shortlist and recent controls remain stable after reordering, keyboard shortcuts do not leak after teardown, and visible counts stay accurate.

queue.title: Privacy Ledger 1.1 strategy regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify scenario-specific control bonuses, control tradeoff explanations, audited and unaudited risk displays, readiness gates, budget composition, equity thresholds, disabled actions, narrow-screen controls, keyboard operation, counsel consequences, unlock pacing, and teardown across all six releases.

queue.title: Permission-free ambient composition game
queue.reason: Explore an audio-first composition experience that uses synthesized local audio without microphone permission, storage, accounts, analytics, or network behavior; require multi-layer tradeoffs, timing, progression, failure, recovery, and mobile-safe controls.

recentDecisions.title: Folding Frontier 1.1.1
recentDecisions.summary: Compared a Folding Frontier keyboard-accessibility repair, a permission-free ambient composition game, and a crisis-negotiation simulator. Prioritized the confirmed live regression: document-level arrow, H, U, and Enter shortcuts also fired while native buttons owned keyboard focus, allowing focused actions to rotate, select, hint, undo, or submit a second game action. Added an interactive-control guard while preserving global shortcuts from the canvas and non-interactive regions, repeated-dialog teardown, reduced motion, pointer support, and the local-only safety boundary.
checks: No storage, permissions, secrets, or network additions

recentDecisions.title: Fabline Control 1.1.1
recentDecisions.summary: Compared a Fabline Control keyboard-accessibility repair, a permission-free ambient composition game, and a crisis-negotiation simulator. Prioritized the queued regression because Fabline's document-level shortcuts also fired while native buttons owned keyboard focus, allowing Enter or arrow activation to trigger both the focused control and a global game action. Added an interactive-control guard while preserving shortcuts elsewhere, repeated-dialog teardown, reduced motion, touch support, and the local-only safety boundary.
checks: No storage, permissions, secrets, or network additions

recentDecisions.title: Folding Frontier gallery wiring
recentDecisions.summary: Compared a Folding Frontier live-gallery repair, a permission-free ambient composition game, and a crisis-negotiation simulator. Prioritized the confirmed release blocker: the validated Folding Frontier source existed on main but index.html never loaded it, preventing the app from appearing in the public collection. Added the missing deferred script wiring without changing permissions, storage, network behavior, or app logic.
checks: No storage, permissions, secrets, or network additions

recentDecisions.title: Relevance Lab 1.1.1
recentDecisions.summary: Compared a Relevance Lab keyboard regression repair, a crisis-negotiation simulator, and a permission-free ambient-sound composition game. Prioritized the confirmed accessibility regression: global shortcuts now ignore interactive controls so native Enter activation cannot also ship a ranking, while game shortcuts remain available elsewhere. The release preserves local-only behavior, reduced motion, touch support, and close teardown.
checks: No storage, permissions, secrets, or network additions

recentDecisions.title: Relevance Lab 1.1.0
recentDecisions.summary: Compared a Relevance Lab strategy pass, a crisis-negotiation simulator, and the open Ambient Ambient feedback proposal. Prioritized the queued search-ranking evidence gap because signals behaved too similarly, experiments exposed too little actionable evidence, and release readiness was hard to read. The release adds scenario-specific signal sensitivities, explicit signal tradeoffs, four visible release gates, blocker-aware experiment reports, clearer commercial-pressure penalties, improved disabled states, narrow-screen controls, and preserved local-only teardown without adding microphone permissions.
checks: No storage, permissions, secrets, or network additions
